features.title: Everything You Need
features.description: PawCal brings together all the tools you need to track your pet's health with data.
features.feature1Desc: Scan barcodes for instant meal logging, portion calculation, calorie tracking.
features.feature2Desc: Monitor weight changes with interactive charts, see healthy ranges.
features.feature3Desc: Notifications for regular meds, vaccines, and parasite treatments.
features.feature4Desc: Log walks, play, and exercise times with customizable goals.
features.feature5Desc: Find the nearest veterinary clinics and pet stores on an interactive map.
features.feature6Desc: Share experiences with other pet owners, learn together.
